summary: Cycle 12 observed: 23 of 27 hold; contradicted: ladders-work, respawn-works, frame-cost, enemies-path. The probe fixes held and made the remaining failures legible. Ladders: the water climb (direct and swimming in) and the shaft climb to the road pass; the strict descent took the ladder over the hatch and rode it down cleanly but ended 46 px inside the cap, still on the ladder — two ladder bugs (overshooting the foot; a hanging ghost sinking between slow frames). Respawn: back in 5.7 s, 125 px from the checkpoint, standing — then knocked 350 px into the basement shaft within 3 s: the bunker checkpoint is 140 px from a guard post. Pathing: the player now waited at the bait; hunters answered (one closed 639 px, others 131-148) but the probe failed on a 250 px knock and its 20 s were wall seconds while the game ran slower. Frame cost: 4.76x (noisy, combat-dependent).

claims.text: ladders-work: capOk (direct and swim-in) and roadOk pass; the water trail shows the ladder taken at once (ladder 1 from the first sample) and the swim-in taken on arrival. downOk fails only at the foot: took at x 2014 on the road (feet -859, 466 ms), descent 100-110 px per sample, never off the ladder (offAbove 0, fastest 350 px/s), but the end state is feet -284, ladder 1 — 46 px below the cap's top, inside the cap, still held. The last tick can step past the foot (up to 260 px/s x 0.25 s), and a ghosted climber with nothing held drifts down: the mod zeroes its velocity each tick but gravity acts within the physics steps of a slow frame.

respawn-works: gone and back (5.7 s; back at x 13885, feet -330, 125 px from the checkpoint at 13760), but 3 s later the player was at x 14112, feet -118, falling down the basement shaft (hatch at 14100 +-70). The checkpoint is 140 px from 'CS Bunker guard' (post, 13900) and 490 px from the shotgun hunter (14250): a respawn into point-blank fire, and a knock into the shaft. A design flaw, not the probe's: checkpoints should not stand in a post's face.

enemies-path: the player held the bait (no deaths, never in a vehicle) but was knocked to x 5950 (worst 250 px), so the probe failed itself. Hunters answered: the 7250 trooper (now a hunter) closed 639 px; the road trooper walked 571 px to the hatch above the bait (closer 131); the marksman closed 148; the heavy went 1394 px east; one trooper fell into the sea. Only one crossed 150.

The pathing window is short in game time: the engine's ThinkNow is given GSPEED in 30 fps ticks, and an operator measurement outside the store (6 s at level 06 as tester) gave 116.65 ticks in 5.74 s — the game runs at about 0.68x wall time here, less when frames are heavier. 20 game seconds, the residue's reading of '20 s', need ~30 wall seconds. The probe should count game time, and put a knocked player back at the bait (a waiting player holds its ground).

frame-cost: perf with the player stood at each spot: baseline 133 ms; start 333, tower span 617 (801 draws), deck 633 (550), road 400: worst 4.76x. Draw counts moved from cycle 11 (deck 666 -> 550, tower span 664 -> 801): the cost follows the fight at the spot. Hiding off-camera soldiers is in, but the spots are where the soldiers are.
coop-ladder and coop-two still hold with the new ladder code: the guest took the water ladder (ladder 1 from the third sample) and climbed to the top (-400).

Next: the mod — a climber held at a tracked position each tick (moved by the climb, never past the top or the foot, put back where it sank), let go standing at the foot; the bunker checkpoint moved out onto the catwalk (13440: 460 px from the post, outside the door, clear of both hatches); baked. The pathing probe counting 20 s of game time and putting a knocked player back. perf.js made as honest (healed every frame, out of any vehicle, stilled, its place checked before and after each spot). After: an in-loop frame matrix at the deck.

unknowns: Whether the heavy's eastward walk is the AI hunting another known threat or a path around something between it and the bait.
